title: The Nine say they are behind nuclear-base sightings
summary: Unnamed guest tells of The Nine say they are behind nuclear-base sightings, about 1970s at nuclear bases, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Uh they kind of say like we're kind of behind a lot of the sightings that that are occurring at nuclear bases.

plain: On a podcast, an unnamed researcher describes messages said to come from "The Nine", a supposed council of non-human beings contacted through recorded sessions in the 1970s. According to this researcher, The Nine claimed that they were behind many of the sightings of strange objects reported at nuclear weapons bases. If true, it would tie those sightings to a single group with a purpose.
